gold: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type

selector.rationale: The presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses and a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells supports Lymphoma, despite unremarkable peripheral-blood flow cytometry.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: The sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells is not consistent with Sarcoidosis.

rejected.label: Panniculitis
rejected.why: The presence of atypical mononuclear cells is not typical for Panniculitis.

rejected.label: Myelofibrosis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy findings do not align with Myelofibrosis.
